question: Find the display names of users who (1) commented on the post titled 'Analysing wind data with R', (2) earned a 'Student' badge in either 2010 or 2011, and (3) have a reputation higher than the user named 'Harlan'.

prediction.sql:
SELECT u."XCL_055"
FROM users AS u
WHERE u."XCL_052" IN (
    SELECT c."XCL_010"
    FROM comments AS c
    JOIN posts AS p ON c."XCL_006" = p."XCL_026"
    WHERE p."XCL_035" = 'Analysing wind data with R'
)
AND u."XCL_052" IN (
    SELECT b."XCL_002"
    FROM badges AS b
    WHERE b."XCL_003" = 'Student'
      AND STRFTIME('%Y', b."XCL_004") IN ('2010', '2011')
)
AND u."XCL_053" > (
    SELECT "XCL_053"
    FROM users
    WHERE "XCL_055" = 'Harlan'
)

FROM users AS u
WHERE u."XCL_052" IN (
    SELECT c."XCL_010"
    FROM comments AS c
    JOIN posts AS p ON c."XCL_006" = p."XCL_026"
    WHERE p."XCL_035" = 'Analysing wind data with R'
)
AND u."XCL_052" IN (
    SELECT b."XCL_002"
    FROM badges AS b
    WHERE b."XCL_003" = 'Student'
      AND STRFTIME('%Y', b."XCL_004") IN ('2010', '2011')
)
AND u."XCL_053" > (
    SELECT "XCL_053"
    FROM users
    WHERE "XCL_055" = 'Harlan'
)
